content_zh:
当朝阳的光辉从地平线的另外一侧浮现时，方正也总算理清楚了自己脑中的记忆，搞清楚了事情的前因后果。
首先，自己的确是死了。这让方正很是无语，一直以来，方正都认为自己是个谨慎的人。他总是习惯做好准备，以应对各种各样的意外风险。从女友分手到公司破产，从资金流断裂到合伙人卷款跑路，从被劫匪谋财害命到过马路时遇见醉驾司机。各种各样的风险和有可能发生的意外都会被方正一一考虑，并且做出对应。他喜欢这种一切都在掌控之中的生活，以不变应万变是方正一直以来的处世哲学，也正因为如此，他才能够拥有今天的成功。
但让方正想不到的是，世界永远是如此奇妙，充满了各种自己无法想象的意外。
比如在他跳入河里救人的时候，方正就没有想过自己会在把人成功救出，并且目送对方上救护车离开后被头顶忽然断开的一根高压线给打个正着。
而让他更没有想到的是自己不但就这么死了，结果再次睁开眼睛却发现自己居然重生到了另外一个世界。
而自己重生的这具身体的主人所发生的事情，让方正也很是无语。
其实说白了事情并不复杂，自己寄宿的这个小贵族家中有一件秘宝，而就在不久之前，有一群来自圣教之国的骑士找到这个小贵族，声称他的家族之中流传的秘宝是一种邪恶而不详的存在，要求他交出秘宝。对此小贵族当然是不愿意，直接把这群骑士赶走了事。原本对此小贵族还没有多想，结果让他们没想到的是，在被赶走的当天晚上，这群骑士就突袭了他们的庄园，大开杀戒。
而这个名叫威廉姆斯的小贵族只是一个小小的爵士，哪儿见过这种场面，自然是吓的带着自家秘宝立刻撒腿就跑。原本他还希望能够进城去寻找其他的贵族家系寻求协助，结果却得知圣教之国已经公开宣布威廉姆斯一家与邪教勾结，被视为秩序之敌发布了追杀令。
圣教之国在这片大陆上地位尊崇，而威廉姆斯这种小贵族根本就是小鱼小虾，自然无法与其相提并论。无奈之下他们只好继续逃亡，但是没想到最终还是没有能够逃出圣教之国的追杀，最终在这里丧命。
如果按照方正第三者的视角去看，那么无疑会认为这个圣教之国一定是那种表面道貌盎然，背地里一肚子男盗女娼喜欢玩小男孩的货色。但是在吸取了这个小贵族的记忆之后，方正郁闷的发现———这圣教之国下的追杀令………还真是一点儿都没冤枉他。
因为按照威廉姆斯的记忆，他们一家人表面上信仰秩序女神，事实上却是一个名叫“毁灭之日”教派的虔诚信徒。这个教派信奉万物的终结，他们声称总有一天世界万物都将毁灭，就连神明也会陨落。而到时将是毁灭之神复活，统治世界之时。这个教派的信徒所要做的，就是尽可能的削弱那些秩序走狗的力量，以等待毁灭之神的回归等等巴拉巴拉的破事。
而理所当然的，威廉姆斯一家也少不了暗地下干一些肮脏黑暗的勾当。按照方正的看法，就算没这个圣教之国替天行道，按照他那个世界的法律去判，这一家子人也够拉出去枪毙一百次了。
自己怎么重生到这么一个货身上？
想到这里，方正就感觉头疼无比，别人穿越的要么是有血海深仇的角色，要么就是有隐藏属性的主角命，干嘛自己就穿越到了这么一个人人喊打的邪教徒身上？
更郁闷的是，通过吸收威廉姆斯的记忆，方正无奈的发现，不但圣教之国那边自己已经成为了榜上有名的通缉犯，就连那个毁灭之日教派，自己也没法待。原因很简单，因为按照威廉姆斯的记忆，那件所谓的教派秘宝，已经被他在逃亡的途中弄坏了！
而秘宝被弄坏的过程更是不值一提，面对圣教之国的追兵，威廉姆斯打算孤注一掷启动那件秘宝来个两败俱伤，结果不知道是具体步骤上出了问题还是他运气不好，在威廉姆斯把魔力灌入那件秘宝的时候，秘宝就“啪”的一声破碎，接着威廉姆斯也直接昏死过去———然后就轮到方正出场了。
活该你被人追杀一辈子！！
方正可以想象，如果自己被毁灭之日教派的人找到，而自己又拿不出那件秘宝，那么真的就只有死路一条了。邪教嘛，不管哪个世界都一样，各种酷刑应有尽有，层出不穷，让你求生不得求死不能。这么一想，说不定被圣教之国给抓了还好点儿，至少人家一剑下去给你个痛快………

content_en:
When the radiance of the morning sun emerged from the other side of the horizon, Fang Zheng finally sorted out the memories in his mind and figured out the cause and effect of the incident.
First of all, he is indeed dead. This left Fang Zheng speechless. Fang Zheng had always considered himself a cautious person. He was always prepared to deal with all kinds of unexpected risks. From the breakup of his girlfriend to the bankruptcy of the company, from the interruption of capital flow to the partner running away with the money, from being murdered by robbers to encountering a drunk driver while crossing the road. All kinds of risks and possible accidents will be considered by Founder one by one and corresponding measures will be made. He likes this kind of life where everything is under control. Fang Zheng has always been a philosophy of life and it is precisely because of this that he is able to achieve today's success.
But what Fang Zheng didn't expect was that the world would always be so wonderful, full of all kinds of surprises that he could not imagine.
For example, when he jumped into the river to save someone, Fang Zheng never thought that he would successfully rescue the person. After watching the person get into the ambulance and leave, he was hit by a high-voltage line that was suddenly disconnected above his head.
What he didn't expect was that not only did he die, but when he opened his eyes again, he found that he was reborn in another world.
And what happened to the owner of his reborn body left Fang Zheng speechless.
In fact, to put it bluntly, the matter is not complicated. There is a secret treasure in the house of the little nobleman where he is staying. Not long ago, a group of knights from the Kingdom of Holy Religion came to this little nobleman, claiming that the secret treasure passed down in his family was an evil and unknown existence, and asked him to hand over the secret treasure. Of course the little noble was unwilling to do this and directly drove these knights away. Originally, the young nobles didn't think much about this, but what they didn't expect was that on the night they were driven away, this group of knights raided their manor and started killing them.
And this little nobleman named Williams was just a little knight. He had never seen such a scene before. Naturally, he was so frightened that he immediately ran away with his secret treasure. Originally, he hoped to go into the city to find other noble families for help, but he learned that the Kingdom of Holy Religion had publicly announced that the Williams family had colluded with the cult, and that they were considered enemies of order and had issued a fatwa.
The Kingdom of the Holy Religion has a respected status on this continent, and small nobles like Williams are simply small fish and shrimps, so naturally they cannot be compared with it. In desperation, they had no choice but to continue fleeing, but they did not expect that they would not be able to escape the pursuit of the Kingdom of the Holy Religion and eventually died here.
If you look at it from the perspective of a third party, you will undoubtedly think that this country of the holy religion must be the kind of person who is sanctimonious on the surface, but secretly full of male thieves and female prostitutes who like to play with little boys. But after absorbing the memory of this little nobleman, Fang Zheng discovered to his dismay that the fatwa issued by the Kingdom of the Holy Religion really did not unfairly accuse him at all.
Because according to Williams' memory, their family ostensibly believed in the Goddess of Order, but in fact they were devout believers in a sect called the "Day of Destruction". This sect believes in the end of all things. They claim that one day everything in the world will be destroyed, and even the gods will fall. And then the God of Destruction will be resurrected and rule the world. What the believers of this sect have to do is to weaken the power of the lackeys of order as much as possible, waiting for the return of the God of Destruction and other things that happen to Barabara.
And of course, the Williams family is bound to do some dirty and dark things secretly. According to Fang Zheng's opinion, even if there was no Kingdom of Holy Religion to uphold justice for heaven, and judged according to the laws of his world, this family could be dragged out and shot a hundred times.
How could I be reborn into such a piece of shit?
Thinking of this, Fang Zheng felt a huge headache. Others who traveled through the time were either people with blood feuds.The character, or the protagonist with hidden attributes, why did he time travel to such a cultist that everyone yelled at to beat him?
What's even more depressing is that by absorbing Williams' memories, Fang Zheng helplessly discovered that not only had he become a wanted criminal on the list of the Holy Religion Kingdom, but he couldn't even wait for the Sun of Destruction sect. The reason is simple, because according to Williams' memory, the so-called secret treasure of the sect had been damaged by him during his escape!
The process of the secret treasure being destroyed is not worth mentioning. Facing the pursuers of the Kingdom of Holy Religion, Williams planned to make a desperate move to activate the secret treasure to hurt both sides. However, it was not clear whether there was a problem with the specific steps or his bad luck. When Williams poured magic power into the secret treasure, the secret treasure shattered with a "pop", and then Williams passed out directly - and then it was Fang Zheng's turn to appear.
You deserve to be hunted for the rest of your life! !
Fang Zheng could imagine that if he was found by someone from the Sun of Destruction sect and he couldn't get the secret treasure, then he would really be dead. Cults are the same no matter which world they are in. There are all kinds of tortures, and they are endless, making you unable to survive or die. Thinking about it this way, maybe it would be better if you were caught by the Kingdom of Holy Religion. At least they would give you a good blow with a sword...
